youtube_title: Shop Refused Your ₹10 Coin? RBI Says It's Valid #Shorts
youtube_description:
Rules Nobody Told You #2. The ₹10 coin has 14 different designs, and RBI has said all of them are legal tender. A different design doesn't mean fake; people stop accepting them because of rumours. RBI has also asked banks to accept coins for transactions and exchange at all their branches. Fix: politely tell the shopkeeper RBI has declared all ₹10 coins valid; if a bank refuses, complain at the branch, then to the RBI Ombudsman.
Source: RBI press release, 17 Jan 2018.
